summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing a broad leadership renewal to drive transformation amid AI's impact. The changes involve internal appointments, including José Luis Elechiguerra as Mexico Country Manager, Pablo Pastor as Head of Global Risk Management, Gloria Couceiro as Colombia Country Manager, Gonzalo Rodríguez as CFO, and several other executive shifts. The reorganization simplifies structure by integrating compliance into risk and discontinuing certain areas. The board, led by Chair Carlos Torres Vila, endorsed the changes. No deal terms, advisors, or shareholder actions are involved; watch for operational execution and strategic direction under the new team.
